title: Pizza with cheese and vegetables, whole wheat thick crust

content.title: About
content.content: Pizza with cheese and vegetables on a whole wheat thick crust combines a crunchy whole‑grain base with melted cheese and fresh vegetables. It offers a balanced mix of carbs, protein, and fiber.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Whole wheat crust provides more fiber and micronutrients than a traditional white crust.
The cheese blend often includes mozzarella and cheddar for optimal melt and flavor.
Vegetables such as tomatoes, bell peppers, onions, and mushrooms add antioxidants as well as taste.
Pizza originated in Naples, Italy, but today there are countless regional variations.
A thin whole wheat crust baked on a stone oven develops a distinctive aroma.

items.title: Rich in fiber
items.content: Whole wheat flour supplies dietary fiber that supports digestive health.

items.title: Source of protein
items.content: Cheese and certain vegetables (e.g., peas) contribute both dairy and plant protein.

items.title: Vitamins and minerals
items.content: Vegetables provide vitamin C, vitamin A, and potassium, while cheese adds calcium and vitamin D.

items.title: Lower glycemic index
items.content: Whole wheat flour releases glucose more slowly than refined flour.

items.title: Antioxidant properties
items.content: Tomato lycopene and other phytochemicals help combat free radicals.

items.title: Lactose intolerance
items.content: Cheese may cause discomfort for people who cannot digest lactose.

items.title: Dairy allergy
items.content: Some individuals are allergic to milk proteins found in cheese.

items.title: High sodium content
items.content: Cheese and sauce can be salty; those monitoring sodium should watch portion size.

items.title: Caloric density
items.content: The crust and cheese make the pizza energy‑dense; moderation is key.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Slice the pizza into serving pieces and enjoy it hot. Add fresh basil or arugula after baking for extra brightness. Drizzle with olive oil or balsamic vinegar if desired.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store leftovers in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 3 days. Reheat in an oven or grill to keep the crust crisp.
